step1_analysis.description: A divide-by-2 frequency divider using a master-slave latch topology. It employs dynamic PMOS loads for precharge and cross-coupled NMOS pairs for state retention, enabling high-speed and low-power operation by avoiding static pull-up loads.

paper_reference.title: A 1-V 2.5-mW 5.2-GHz Frequency Divider in a 0.35-m CMOS Process

operating_frequency.description: The output frequency of the circuit, which should be exactly half of the input clock frequency (divide-by-2 operation).

sky130_expected.calculation: Simulated with a 2 GHz input clock, the output frequency should be 1 GHz. Max frequency depends heavily on the L=0.5um sizing used in the netlist.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The paper achieved 5.2 GHz in 0.35um at 1V. With SKY130 at 1.8V but using L=0.5um (larger than minimum channel length), the speed will be comparable or slightly lower due to the increased gate capacitance and transit time.

power_consumption.description: Average power drawn from the VDD supply during continuous toggling.

sky130_expected.calculation: P = I_avg * VDD. At 1.8V and 2 GHz input, dynamic power dominates.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Higher supply voltage (1.8V vs 1V) will significantly increase dynamic power (proportional to V^2), even if node capacitances are similar to the original paper.

output_voltage_swing.description: Peak-to-peak voltage swing of the output nodes.

sky130_expected.reasoning: The cross-coupled NMOS pairs pull down to 0V, and the PMOS dynamic loads pull up to VDD (1.8V). Ratioed logic during the evaluation phase might cause slight VOL degradation, but the cross-coupled pairs will restore full swing.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis with a 2 GHz differential clock to verify divide-by-2 operation, measure output frequency, power consumption, and voltage swing.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Frequency Divider Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xmp1=5u L_xmp1=0.5u
.param W_xmp2=5u L_xmp2=0.5u
.param W_xmp3=5u L_xmp3=0.5u
.param W_xmp4=5u L_xmp4=0.5u
.param W_xmn1=5u L_xmn1=0.5u
.param W_xmn2=5u L_xmn2=0.5u
.param W_xmn3=5u L_xmn3=0.5u
.param W_xmn4=5u L_xmn4=0.5u
.param W_xmn5=5u L_xmn5=0.5u
.param W_xmn6=5u L_xmn6=0.5u
.param W_xmn7=5u L_xmn7=0.5u
.param W_xmn8=5u L_xmn8=0.5u
.param W_xmn9=5u L_xmn9=0.5u
.param W_xmn10=5u L_xmn10=0.5u
.param W_xmn11=5u L_xmn11=0.5u
.param W_xmn12=5u L_xmn12=0.5u

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
* 2 GHz Differential Clock (Period = 500ps)
VCLK CLK 0 PULSE(0 1.8 0 20p 20p 230p 500p)
VCLKBAR CLKBAR 0 PULSE(1.8 0 0 20p 20p 230p 500p)

* DUT
XMP1 N_L1 CLKBAR VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmp1} w={W_xmp1}
XMP2 N_L2 CLKBAR VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmp2} w={W_xmp2}
XMP3 N_R1 CLK VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmp3} w={W_xmp3}
XMP4 N_R2 CLK VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmp4} w={W_xmp4}
XMN1 N_L1 N_L2 N_TL1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmn1} w={W_xmn1}
XMN2 N_L2 N_L1 N_TL1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmn2} w={W_xmn2}
XMN3 N_TL1 CLKBAR GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmn3} w={W_xmn3}
XMN4 N_L1 N_R1 N_TL2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmn4} w={W_xmn4}
XMN5 N_L2 N_R2 N_TL2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmn5} w={W_xmn5}
XMN6 N_TL2 CLK GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmn6} w={W_xmn6}
XMN7 N_R1 N_R2 N_TR1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmn7} w={W_xmn7}
XMN8 N_R2 N_R1 N_TR1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmn8} w={W_xmn8}
XMN9 N_TR1 CLK GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmn9} w={W_xmn9}
XMN10 N_R1 N_L2 N_TR2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmn10} w={W_xmn10}
XMN11 N_R2 N_L1 N_TR2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmn11} w={W_xmn11}
XMN12 N_TR2 CLKBAR GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmn12} w={W_xmn12}

* Load capacitors to simulate next stage
C1 N_L1 0 5f
C2 N_L2 0 5f
C3 N_R1 0 5f
C4 N_R2 0 5f

.control
tran 5p 10n

* Measure output frequency (should be 1 GHz for a 2 GHz input)
meas tran t_period trig v(N_L1) val=0.9 rise=4 targ v(N_L1) val=0.9 rise=5
let out_freq = 1 / t_period
print out_freq

* Measure average power consumption
meas tran pwr avg i(VVDD) from=2n to=10n
let power_mw = -pwr * 1.8 * 1000
print power_mw

* Measure output voltage swing
meas tran v_max max v(N_L1) from=2n to=10n
meas tran v_min min v(N_L1) from=2n to=10n

quit
.endc
